about.bio: I am Samir Hashimov, a Junior Front-End Developer. I build and publish my own apps. My link management platform, Blink, is available on the web, Google Play, and as a Firefox extension. Currently, I am deepening my knowledge of the React ecosystem, exploring TypeScript, and transitioning to Tailwind.

descriptions.blink: A centralized platform for organizing, managing, and securely sharing links and resources.
descriptions.ipekchi: A modern e-commerce store offering carefully selected clothing and accessories for everyday life.
descriptions.blog101: A minimal blog platform for sharing ideas, personal writing, and stories with readers.
descriptions.brandkit: A tool for finding popular brand icons, getting embed code, and integrating them through NPM.
descriptions.snap: A platform that helps remote teams manage workflows, tasks, and collaboration.
